claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_vehicle / item_locomotion
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet itself gains fly speed and moves as a pilotable vehicle; the rider is a passenger, not the subject of a grant_speed atom. No existing family or atom models an item acquiring its own movement mode and carrying passengers.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_command_radius on ActivatedAbilityMechanics or a new vehicle family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet responds to directional commands only when the commander is within 30 ft. No surface field expresses a remote-control radius for an item's ongoing movement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: weight_capacity predicate for conditional speed modification
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet's fly speed is halved when carrying more than its normal capacity (up to 2× capacity). No existing EquipmentPredicate or OngoingPredicate models a cargo-weight threshold.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
